children: Qflow Group AB (publ) announces that the company has decided to change the publication date of its interim report for the third quarter of 2026.
The previously communicated date was 5 November 2026. The new publication date is 10 November 2026.
Qflow Group brings together the best consultants in the built environment, and together we create a smarter and more sustainable society — through innovation and collaboration for the future.

Today, Qflow comprises 41 companies within the Group, with approximately 1,350 consultants and revenue of approximately SEK 2,500 million. Qflow is a leading player in the built environment consultancy market and brings together leading specialists in the sector.

Our network includes some of the best consultants to create better flow in the construction and infrastructure sector. We do this through smarter project management and technical solutions. Together, Qflow Group helps connect a fragmented value chain and identify synergies between contractors that can promote innovation and development.
